items.title: NCTAMS PAC CAIRS Support

value.quote: The Defense Information Systems Agency/Defense Information Technology Contracting Organization intends to negotiate a sole source contract with Unique Communications Solutions.

items.context: The Defense Information Systems Agency/Defense Information Technology Contracting Organization intends to negotiate a sole source contract with Unique Communications Solutions. A sole source Justification & Approval document is being coordinated and, upon approval, a copy of it will be posted here on SAM.gov to comply with the public display requirements of FAR 6.301. The proposed contract action is for software access and continuous contracted maintenance support to keep Naval Computer and Telecommunications Area Master Station Pacific (NCTAMS PAC) subordinate sites Configuration Accounting Information Retrieval System (CAIRS) software packages current to meet JITC and IA security requirements in support of NCTAMS PAC regional BCO mission requirements. The current contract is in its fifth and final year. DITCO-PAC is establishing a new contract for one base year with four option periods. The consolidated contract supports Naval Computer and Telecommunications Station Far East (NCTS FE) to include Diego Garcia, NCTS Guam (NCTS GU), and NCTS San Diego (NCTS SD) and NCTS Detachment Puget Sound (NCTS PS). In Option Year One, services will include NCTAMS PAC in Wahiawa, Hawaii. The NCTAMS PAC Hawaii infrastructure is currently being installed and accredited at the estimated time of award and is not projected to need services/support until Q3/Q4 of 2027. At this time, the incumbent contractor Unique Communications Solutions is the only source capable of providing all necessary services for the NCTAMS PAC area of responsibility (AOR). Unique Communications Solutions is the sole OEM provider for the Configuration Accounting Information Retrieval System (CAIRS). The CAIRS system is unique in its functionality and features. There are no other companies that provide a system that has the exact components and abilities. CAIRS is trademarked through Unique Communications Solutions only. The Software Upgrade Kits are specific to the software they support. Unique Communications Solutions is the only company that can directly perform the following with the CAIRS programs: Upgrades, Update, Add Features, Fix Software problems, provide standard maintenance, Give training and technical support, Onsite Installation and Training.
